changelog:
[COLOR fffdb515]AIOStreams[/COLOR]
-Your own AIOStreams instance can now be used, such as a paid ElfHosted : choose Custom URL under Instance and enter its address, for example https://your-username-aiostreams.elfhosted.com, with your UUID and password.
-Instead of UUID and password you can paste the manifest URL your instance gives you after saving the configuration, since it already carries your account. Configure page links and stremio:// links work too.
-New AIOStreams Setup Wizard: link your account from a browser on another device, with no need for the Kodi keyboard. Whatever address or manifest URL you paste picks the instance by itself.
-The account is checked against the instance before anything is saved: a wrong password, or an account that lives on another instance, is reported right away and names the instance that was asked, instead of silently returning no sources.
-The wizard warns when your AIOStreams configuration offers no streams yet (no addons added, or all of them failing), which otherwise just shows up as zero sources.
-New Debrid detected field with a Re-detect button: it shows which debrid services your AIOStreams account uses, read with your UUID and password. With only a manifest URL it cannot be read, and the field says so.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-AIOStreams: after switching instance, the login of the previous one is no longer reused for the rest of the session, and the wizard refreshes it whenever you link an account.
-AIOStreams configuration links shortened with an alias are now masked in the log like the rest.
